name: Title bar
description: Draws the bar at the top of each window: the commands, the vault and the window buttons

settings.title: Window buttons
settings.description: Side of the bar the window buttons are drawn on
settings.details: Where the bar draws the window buttons. macOS always draws them on the left.

options.title: Left
options.detail: Round buttons at the left, as on macOS.

options.title: Right
options.detail: Square buttons at the right, as on Windows.

options.title: None
options.detail: The bar draws no window buttons.

settings.title: Hide in full screen
settings.description: Hide the bar while the window is full screen

settings.title: Slots
settings.description: Order and visibility of what plugins place here
settings.details: Choose which entries of each slot are shown, and in what order.
